# package lldp

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/lldp"
```

Package lldp implements the Link Layer Discovery Protocol (IEEE 802.1AB) with the organizationally specific TLVs PROFINET uses (IEC 61158-6-10: OUI 00-0E-CF) and the IEEE 802.3 MAC/PHY TLV: the frame codec, and an agent that announces the local port and keeps a table of neighbors with expiry.

PROFINET builds topology on LLDP: a device derives its AliasName from its neighbor's port and chassis IDs, and controllers read the neighbor table (PDPortDataReal) to check the wiring. Generic LLDP describes links; the PROFINET TLVs add the RT class port status, the chassis MAC and the line delay.

### type AgentOptions

```go
type AgentOptions struct {
	// Interval is the transmit interval; zero means 5 s. A negative value
	// makes the agent receive only.
	Interval time.Duration
	// TTLFactor × Interval is the TTL announced; zero means 4.
	TTLFactor int
	// Local returns the information to announce; it is called for every
	// frame. nil makes the agent receive only.
	Local func() LocalInfo
	// MaxNeighbors bounds the table; zero means 16.
	MaxNeighbors int
	// OnChange is called after the neighbor table changed: a frame
	// arrived (new or refreshed information), a neighbor expired or left
	// (TTL 0), or Clear was called. It runs on the agent's goroutines,
	// never with the agent's lock held, and must not block.
	OnChange func()
	Logger   profinet.Logger
}
```

AgentOptions configure an [Agent](#type-agent).

```go
type Frame struct {
	ChassisSubtype uint8  `json:"chassisSubtype"`
	ChassisID      []byte `json:"chassisId"`

	// TTL is the time to live in seconds; 0 withdraws the information.
	TTL               uint16     `json:"ttl"`
	PortDescription   string     `json:"portDescription,omitempty"`
	SystemName        string     `json:"systemName,omitempty"`
	SystemDescription string     `json:"systemDescription,omitempty"`
	ManagementAddr    netip.Addr `json:"managementAddress"`
	// ManagementIfIndex is the interface number (ifIndex subtype) of the
	// IPv4 Management Address TLV; the agent sends 1.
	// ManagementOID is the TLV's object identifier, BER encoded without
	// tag and length (empty when none). Siemens devices send ifIndex = the
	// port's number and the PNO enterprise OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.24686
	// (testdata/captures, ics-pcaps/*_lldp.pcap*).
	ManagementIfIndex uint32        `json:"managementIfIndex,omitempty"`
	ManagementOID     []byte        `json:"managementOid,omitempty"`
	PortStatus        *PortStatus   `json:"portStatus,omitempty"`
	ChassisMAC        *ethernet.MAC `json:"chassisMac,omitempty"`
	Delay             *Delay        `json:"delay,omitempty"`
	MACPHY            *MACPHY       `json:"macPhy,omitempty"`
	// Other holds the TLVs this package does not decode.
	Other []TLV `json:"-"`
}
```

Frame is a decoded LLDP data unit.

#### func Decode

```go
func Decode(b []byte) (Frame, error)
```

Decode decodes an LLDPDU. The mandatory Chassis ID, Port ID and TTL TLVs must come first, in that order; decoding stops at the End TLV (or the end of b, since padding may follow a missing End TLV).

#### func (Frame) AppendTo

```go
func (f *Frame) AppendTo(dst []byte) ([]byte, error)
```

AppendTo appends the encoded LLDPDU (the Ethernet payload) to dst.


ChassisString returns the chassis ID as text: a MAC address for the MAC subtype, the octets otherwise.

### type Neighbor

```go
type Neighbor struct {
	// MAC is the source address of the neighbor's frames.
	MAC     ethernet.MAC `json:"mac"`
	Frame   Frame        `json:"frame"`
	Updated time.Time    `json:"updated"`
	Expires time.Time    `json:"expires"`
	// Index numbers the neighbor for as long as the agent knows it: the
	// agent gives each new neighbor the next number from 1 to 2^31-1 (an
	// LLDP-MIB lldpRemIndex) and, when it wraps, skips the numbers of the
	// current neighbors. A neighbor that expires or leaves and comes back
	// gets a new number.
	Index uint32 `json:"index"`
	// Changed is when the neighbor first appeared or its identity last
	// changed: its address, chassis and port IDs, port description,
	// system name or description (the LLDP-MIB's lldpRemTable columns).
	// Frames that only refresh it, or change other TLVs (a measured
	// delay), leave it.
	Changed time.Time `json:"changed"`
}
```

Neighbor is an entry of the neighbor table.

#### func (Neighbor) Alias

Alias returns the PROFINET AliasName of the device connected to this neighbor: the neighbor's port ID, followed by "." and its chassis ID unless the port ID already carries the station name.
